title: spilanthes americana var. parvula
intro: Spilanthes americana var. parvula, commonly known as American Spilanthes or Small Spilanthes, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Acanthaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, wounds, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include spilanthol, a sesquiterpene lactone responsible for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive compounds present in Spilanthes americana var. parvula also possess antioxidant and immunomodulatory properties, contributing to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
